label: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE
title: Launch announcement / APAC fintech — synthetic audience report

summary.recommendation: Announce pricing in the launch post, but lead with the reliability evidence and publish a cost calculator the same day.
summary.text: The synthetic population leans supportive overall (46% by tick 24), but the loudest objections come from a small, influential finance-reviewer segment whose concerns cascade into SMEs. The objection wave at tick 12 was driven by per-seat cost uncertainty; it softened when cost predictability messaging appeared in later ticks. Reliability-first operators moved supportive fastest when incident-history evidence was referenced directly.

claims.text: The tick-12 objection wave originated in finance reviewers and cascaded into SME cohorts.
